name: Lóbais
text: Lóbais is named in the sources as the druid of the Fomorians. The entry is a bare identification: the dictionary records no deeds, no family, and no tale attachment for him. His significance rests on the two roles the notice joins, the priestly office of druid and the hostile Fomorian people he serves.
